traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Ceratophyllaceae: leaves whorled; leaves simple or compound; stipules absent; leaf rosettes none; plants monoecious; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit achene; stamens (5-) 10 to 20 (-27); carpels 1. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 272, family Ceratophyllaceae: leaf margin serrate (serrulate); read as "serrate".

traits.leaf_incision.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 272, family Ceratophyllaceae: leaf incision dissected, dichotomously forked; read as "dissected".

traits.inflorescence.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 272, family Ceratophyllaceae: inflorescence solitary; read as "solitary".

traits.flowering_position.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 272, family Ceratophyllaceae: flowering position lateral (axillary); read as "lateral".

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 272, family Ceratophyllaceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".

traits.anchorage.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 272, family Ceratophyllaceae: anchorage none; anchored by rootlike branches; read as "none".
